column1: # Wiring-claim manifest (#1100). Machine-readable form of wiring-claims.md.
#   id       stable row id, matching the audit table
#   doc      the document whose claim is checked
#              no-callers:<needle>:<exclude>   no file outside <exclude> may contain needle
#              declares-gap:<path>:<needle>    doc must still declare the gap
#   claim    one line, for the failure message
# A CONFIRMED row fails when its evidence disappears. A GAP row fails when the
# document stops declaring the gap (the overclaim came back) or when callers
# appear (the gap was closed and the row should be promoted).

column5: capacity is reserved before a step dispatches
the capacity seam is armed in all three roots
a precondition check runs before dispatch
the sequence policy gates dispatch and is consulted at plan time
an approval is verified against its intent before dispatch, in all three roots
when the approved intent declares a scope, the run's effects are diffed against it; plan creation declares it for file actions
envelopes are tagged with the anchor regime in all three roots
anchored mode verifies cross-run history through the anchor adapter
process spawning is confined to the approved sinks and clears the child env
hooks run around tool calls in all three roots
budget counters are evaluated before every tool call, on both dispatch paths and in all three roots
recovery recipes are attachable by every entry point (opt-in via RIGORIX_RECOVERY)
every root calls from_env; a present declaration arms the seam and an absent one leaves it off
when the seam is armed, the intent is recorded before dispatch and settled after
every root calls reconcile; the ledger capability decides: L1 sweeps, L2 declines and the service owns it
